title: claytonia rupestris
intro: Claytonia rupestris, commonly known as Mountain Spring Beauty, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Portulacaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Claytonia rupestris include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and diuretic properties, which can help alleviate symptoms associated with conditions such as kidney stones and urinary tract infections. Bioactive constituents present in Claytonia rupestris include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
